methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 real, independently re-verified portable and in-ground basketball hoop systems spanning entry-level (Lifetime, Silverback Junior) through premium/gym-grade tiers (Goalrilla CV72, Pro Dunk/THOR Gold). Each product's price and headline specs were re-checked on 2026-08-19 against the manufacturer's own live product page (goalrilla.com, produnk.com, goalsetter.com, spalding.com, spalding-basketball.com, escaladesports.com, lifetime.com); hobbyist/retailer pages were used only to corroborate. height_adjustment_range_ft and backboard_overhang_in are manufacturer-published figures; base_capacity_gal applies only to portable water/sand-filled bases and is null otherwise; breakaway_rim is true for spring-loaded/breakaway rims, false for rigid 'classic' rims. Corrections applied during verification: Lifetime 71799 Action Grip is INFINITE adjustment (not 3in increments); Lifetime 90491 price set null (official page publishes no price, retailer verification 403); Pro Dunk THOR Gold overhang range corrected to 48-65in (page states 48/56/65 at 10/8/6ft); Spalding Momentous board height dropped to '54 in' (only 54in confirmed on page); Spalding Gold TF overhang nulled (not published); Silverback SB54 name normalized (Escalade brands its 54in in-ground tier SB54/SB54IG, not 'SBX 54'); Lifetime 1269 source swapped to a reachable review because the Walmart page is CAPTCHA-walled. No fabricated products were found. accessedAt 2026-08-19.

products.name: Goalrilla GS54 (GS54C)
products.priceNote: Official goalrilla.com listed price ($1,749.95); item currently 'Sold Out Online' but page live with price shown
products.provenance: Re-verified on Goalrilla's own product page (2026-08-19): $1,749.95, 54x34in 3/8in tempered glass, one-piece 5x5in pole, 2.5ft max overhang, medium-weight pro-style breakaway rim. Page did not print the numeric height range; 7.5-10ft is the standard Goalrilla GS-series in-ground range.

products.name: Goalsetter Contender

products.name: Spalding Momentous EZ Assembly 54" Arena View Portable
products.provenance: Re-verified on Spalding's own product page (2026-08-19): $999.99, 54in clear performance acrylic board, Arena Slam breakaway rim, 36-gallon water/sand base, 2.75in square pole, 8-10ft, 18in offset. CORRECTED backboard_size: page confirms only the 54in width; the draft's 'x 32in' board height was not stated on the page, so it was dropped to avoid a guess.

products.name: Silverback NXT 54 (In-Ground)
products.priceNote: Official escaladesports.com sale price (list $599.95); a portable NXT 54 variant is separately priced
products.provenance: Re-verified on Escalade's official page (2026-08-19; SKU B8402W): $569.95 (from $599.95), 54w x 33H backboard, in-ground concrete-set steel pole, 7.5-10ft all-steel actuator, pro-style breakaway rim. Tempered-glass backboard is the defining feature of the NXT (glass) line vs the acrylic SBX line.
